title: Bind sparse arrays along one margin.

origin.example:
.libPaths(c(path.expand("~/R/library"), .libPaths()))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(slam))

a <- as.simple_sparse_array(matrix(c(1, 0, 0, 0), 2, 2))
b <- as.simple_sparse_array(matrix(c(0, 0, 2, 0), 2, 2))

translation.description: Bind sparse arrays along one margin.

translation.value: The same value R returns for this call.
translation.example:
import numpy as np
from slam import abind_simple_sparse_array, as_simple_sparse_array
from slam._arrays import as_array
a = as_simple_sparse_array(np.array([1, 0, 0, 0], dtype=float).reshape((2, 2), order='F'))
b = as_simple_sparse_array(np.array([0, 0, 2, 0], dtype=float).reshape((2, 2), order='F'))
print(as_array(abind_simple_sparse_array(a, b, margin=1)))
